name: kritzel
description: Public demos and editor packages for Kritzel.

scripts.build:editor: npm run build -w editor/core && npm run build -w editor/angular && npm run build -w editor/react && npm run build -w editor/vue
scripts.build:demos: npm run build-app -w demos/angular && npm run build-app -w demos/react && npm run build-app -w demos/vue
scripts.build:demos:pages: npm run build-app -w demos/angular -- --base-href /kritzel/angular/ && npm run build-app -w demos/react -- --base /kritzel/react/ && npm run build-app -w demos/vue -- --base /kritzel/vue/
